name: honor-product-receipts
description: Verify the four configured Honor Developer Products, live Marketplace identity/prices, durable receipt core, bounded world offers, dedicated Shop tab, and safe purchase controls without opening a checkout prompt.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='Honor Products Flow Phone 740x360' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=740,Height=360,PixelDensity=96,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Phone} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.3) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({width=r.X,height=r.Y,active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local M=game:GetService('MarketplaceService') local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local expected={{'HonorPouch25','Honor Pouch',25,29,3708804891},{'HonorCache90','Honor Cache',90,79,3708804911},{'HonorVault300','Honor Vault',300,199,3708804933},{'HonorTreasury850','Honor Treasury',850,499,3708804944}} local rows={} local worldOffers=0 local ids,honorSeen={},{} local valid=#G.PremiumProducts==8 for _,p in ipairs(G.PremiumProducts) do local id=tonumber(p.productId) or 0 valid=valid and id>0 and id%1==0 and not ids[id] ids[id]=true if p.worldOffer~=false then worldOffers+=1 end end for _,p in ipairs(G.PremiumPets) do local id=tonumber(p.gamePassId) or 0 valid=valid and id>0 and not ids[id] end for index,e in ipairs(expected) do local p=G.PremiumProducts[index+4] local lookup,info=pcall(function() return M:GetProductInfoAsync(e[5],Enum.InfoType.Product) end) local livePrice=lookup and tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) or 0 local exact=p and p.id==e[1] and p.displayName==e[2] and p.honor==e[3] and p.robux==e[4] and p.productId==e[5] and p.shopPage=='Honor' and p.worldOffer==false and not honorSeen[e[5]] and lookup and info.Name==e[2] and livePrice>0 and info.IsForSale==true honorSeen[e[5]]=true rows[#rows+1]={id=p and p.id,productId=p and p.productId,honor=p and p.honor,configuredBasePrice=p and p.robux,liveName=lookup and info.Name,livePrice=livePrice,forSale=lookup and info.IsForSale,exact=exact==true} valid=valid and exact end valid=valid and worldOffers==4 local root=workspace:WaitForChild('PunchWallRPG') local physical=0 local honorPhysical=0 for _,d in ipairs(root.Interactables:GetChildren()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') and d.Name:find(' Premium Offer',1,true) then physical+=1 if d:GetAttribute('ProductKey') and tostring(d:GetAttribute('ProductKey')):find('Honor',1,true) then honorPhysical+=1 end end end valid=valid and physical==4 and honorPhysical==0 local result={ok=valid,rows=rows,worldOffers=worldOffers,physical=physical,honorPhysical=honorPhysical} assert(valid,'Honor product config/metadata/world failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: four Honor products and four existing world offers are exact

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage:WaitForChild('PunchWallAutomation') local rows={} local ok=true for _,id in ipairs({'HonorPouch25','HonorCache90','HonorVault300','HonorTreasury850'}) do local r=c:Invoke('HonorProductReceiptContract',id) ok=ok and r.ok==true rows[#rows+1]=r end local result={ok=ok,rows=rows} assert(ok,'Honor receipt core failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: Honor receipt first replay mismatch overflow and reconcile are exact

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local M=game:GetService('MarketplaceService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') assert(a:Invoke('OpenTab','Fists')==true,'Shop host did not open') assert(a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Honor')==true,'Honor Shop did not open') local s=g.GameMenu:FindFirstChild('FunctionalHeroShop') local tabs=s and s:FindFirstChild('ShopTabs') local expected={{'HonorPouch25',25,1,3708804891},{'HonorCache90',90,2,3708804911},{'HonorVault300',300,3,3708804933},{'HonorTreasury850',850,4,3708804944}} local deadline=os.clock()+8 local resolved=false repeat task.wait(.1) resolved=true for _,e in ipairs(expected) do local card=s and s:FindFirstChild(e[1]..'ShopCard',true) resolved=resolved and card and card:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true end until resolved or os.clock()>=deadline local rows={} local ok=resolved and s~=nil and s.Visible==true and tabs~=nil and tabs:FindFirstChild('HonorShopTab')~=nil and s:GetAttribute('ShopCatalogItemCount')==4 for _,e in ipairs(expected) do local card=s and s:FindFirstChild(e[1]..'ShopCard',true) local action=card and card:FindFirstChild(e[1]..'Action',true) local name=card and card:FindFirstChild('Name',true) local rarity=card and card:FindFirstChild('Rarity',true) local detail=card and card:FindFirstChild('Detail',true) local lookup,info=pcall(function() return M:GetProductInfoAsync(e[4],Enum.InfoType.Product) end) local live=lookup and tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) or 0 local amountVisible=name and rarity and (name.Text:find(e[2]..' HONOR',1,true)~=nil or rarity.Text:find('+'..e[2]..' HONOR',1,true)~=nil) local exact=card and action and name and rarity and detail and amountVisible and lookup and info.IsForSale==true and card:GetAttribute('ProductId')==e[4] and card:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and card:GetAttribute('PurchaseUnavailable')==false and card:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true and card:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice')==live and action:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice')==live and card:GetAttribute('HonorPackPipCount')==e[3] and detail.Text:find('+'..e[2]..' Honor',1,true)~=nil and action.Active==true and action.Selectable==true and action:GetAttribute('ShopActionBound')==true and action.Text=='BUY' and action.TextFits==true and action.AbsoluteSize.X>=44 and action.AbsoluteSize.Y>=44 rows[#rows+1]={id=e[1],productId=card and card:GetAttribute('ProductId'),price=card and card:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice'),livePrice=live,exact=exact==true,text=action and action.Text,pips=card and card:GetAttribute('HonorPackPipCount'),size=action and tostring(action.AbsoluteSize)} ok=ok and exact end local result={ok=ok==true,rows=rows,tabs=tabs and #tabs:GetChildren(),items=s and s:GetAttribute('ShopCatalogItemCount')} assert(result.ok,'Honor Shop live configured state failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: four Honor cards resolve exact live prices and bind safe purchase actions

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local gui=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=gui:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') local shop=gui.GameMenu:WaitForChild('FunctionalHeroShop') local key='HonorPouch25' local function findAction() local card=shop:FindFirstChild(key..'ShopCard',true) return card and card:FindFirstChild(key..'Action',true) end local action=findAction() assert(action and action.Active and action.Selectable,'ready action missing') local expected={{'Opening','OPEN'},{'CheckoutOpen','ROBLOX'},{'Verifying','VERIFY'},{'Granted','ADDED'}} local rows={} local ok=true for _,entry in ipairs(expected) do assert(a:Invoke('SetPurchaseUiState',{productKey=key,state=entry[1],message=entry[1]})==true,'state injection rejected') local deadline=os.clock()+2 repeat task.wait(.05) action=findAction() until (action and action:GetAttribute('PurchaseUiState')==entry[1]) or os.clock()>=deadline local exact=action and action.Text==entry[2] and action.TextFits==true and action.TextWrapped==false and action.AbsoluteSize.X>=44 and action.AbsoluteSize.Y>=44 and action.Active==false and action.Selectable==false rows[#rows+1]={state=entry[1],text=action and action.Text,fits=action and action.TextFits,size=action and tostring(action.AbsoluteSize),exact=exact==true} ok=ok and exact end assert(a:Invoke('SetPurchaseUiState',{productKey=key,state='Canceled',message='PURCHASE CANCELED • NO CHARGE'})==true,'cancel injection rejected') local deadline=os.clock()+2 repeat task.wait(.05) action=findAction() until (action and action:GetAttribute('PurchaseUiState')=='Canceled' and action.Active==true) or os.clock()>=deadline local canceled=action and action.Text=='BUY' and action.TextFits==true and action.Active==true and action.Selectable==true ok=ok and canceled a:Invoke('SetPurchaseUiState',{productKey=key,state='Idle',message=''}) local result={ok=ok==true,rows=rows,canceledText=action and action.Text,canceled=canceled==true,viewport='740x339'} assert(result.ok,'compact purchase states failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: compact transient purchase states and cancel recovery fit

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') pcall(function() S:StopSimulationAsync() end) local removed=0 for _,id in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id) if info.Name=='Honor Products Flow Phone 740x360' and info.IsCustom then S:RemoveDeviceAsync(id) removed+=1 end end return H:JSONEncode({default=S:GetDeviceAsync()=='default',removed=removed})

steps.label: restore default viewport and remove Honor flow device

args.code: local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') pcall(function() S:StopSimulationAsync() end) for _,id in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id) if info.Name=='Honor Products Flow Phone 740x360' and info.IsCustom then pcall(function() S:RemoveDeviceAsync(id) end) end end return true
